# PPLGYM_SAMPLE  — forward semi-Markov walk w/ momentum (semiMarkovWalk(6,1) = 6 states = 2 inits + 4 transitions)
function walk_end()
    s2 = Gen.random(normal, 200.0, 1.0)      # init state 1
    s1 = Gen.random(normal, 200.0, 1.0)      # init state 2
    for _ in 1:4
        mom = (s1 - s2) * 0.7
        snew = Gen.random(normal, s1 + mom, 3.0)
        s2 = s1; s1 = snew
    end
    return s1 > 200.0                         # last state (6)
end
draws = Bool[]
for i in 1:4000; push!(draws, walk_end()); end
ANSWER = draws

function qudAnswer(qud, price, valence)
    qud == "price" ? Dict("price"=>price) :
    qud == "valence" ? Dict("valence"=>valence) :
    Dict("price"=>price, "valence"=>valence)
end

# L0 cache: (utt_idx, qud_idx, theta_idx) -> Dict(qudvalue => prob)
L0cache = Dict{Tuple{Int,Int,Int}, Dict{Any,Float64}}()
for ui in 1:nutt, qi in 1:nqud, thi in 1:nprices
    u = utterances[ui]; qud = quds[qi]; theta = prices[thi]
    @gen function m()
        pidx = ({:price} ~ uniform_discrete(1, nprices))
        price = prices[pidx]
        v = ({:valence} ~ bernoulli(valenceProb[price]))
        {:cond} ~ bernoulli(meaningOk(u, price, theta) ? 1.0 : 0.0)
        return qudAnswer(qud, price, v)
    end
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:cond, true)),
        choice_vol_grid((:price, collect(1:nprices)), (:valence, [true, false])))
    w = exp.(lw)
    d = Dict{Any,Float64}()
    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w)
        r = get_retval(t)
        d[r] = get(d, r, 0.0) + wi
    end
    tot = sum(values(d))
    for k in keys(d); d[k] = d[k] / tot; end
    L0cache[(ui, qi, thi)] = d
end

scoreL0(d, val) = LOG(get(d, val, 0.0))

# S1 cache: (price_idx, valence_bool, qud_idx, theta_idx) -> prob vector over utterances

function meaningProb(uttIdx, state, interp)
    if uttIdx == 1
        if interp == "thePerson"
            return state == "person" ? (1.0 - personNoise) : personNoise
        else
            return state == "drink" ? (1.0 - drinkNoise) : drinkNoise
        end
    elseif uttIdx == 2
        return state == "person" ? 1.0 : 0.0
    else
        return state == "drink" ? 1.0 : 0.0
    end
end

function literalListenerDist(uttIdx, interp)
    @gen function m()
        si = ({:s} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 2))
        state = states[si]
        p = meaningProb(uttIdx, state, interp)
        {:c} ~ bernoulli(p)
        return si
    end
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:c, true)), choice_vol_grid((:s, collect(1:2))))
    w = exp.(lw)
    d = zeros(2)
    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w)
        d[get_retval(t)] += wi
    end
    tot = sum(d)
    return tot > 0 ? d ./ tot : d
end

function L0joint(u)
    @gen function m()
        si = ({:s} ~ uniform_discrete(1,4))
        vali = ({:val} ~ categorical([pgood[si], 1-pgood[si]]))
        aroi = ({:aro} ~ categorical([plow[si], 1-plow[si]]))

    end
    tr,lw,_ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:c,true)),
                 choice_vol_grid((:s,collect(1:4)),(:val,[1,2]),(:aro,[1,2])))
    w = exp.(lw)
    d = Dict{Tuple{Int,Int,Int},Float64}()
    for (t,wi) in zip(tr,w)
        k = get_retval(t)

    tot = sum(values(d))

antisoc   = [ lambda * sum(stateMarg[u][s]*s for s in 1:4) for u in 1:4 ]

function qudval(goali, u, si, vali, aroi)
    goali==1 ? LOG(stateMarg[u][si]) : goali==2 ? LOG(valMarg[u][vali]) : LOG(aroMarg[u][aroi])
end

function S1(si, phii, goali, vali, aroi)
    phi = phis[phii]
    @gen function m()
        ui = ({:u} ~ uniform_discrete(1,4))
        util = phi*qudval(goali,ui,si,vali,aroi) + (1-phi)*antisoc[ui]
        {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(alpha*util)
        return ui
    end
    tr,lw,_ = enumerative_inference(m,(),choicemap((:pot,0.0)),choice_vol_grid((:u,collect(1:4))))
    w = exp.(lw); d = zeros(4)
    for (t,wi) in zip(tr,w); d[get_retval(t)] += wi; end
    return d ./ sum(d)
end

utterances = [
    "all of the blond people are nice",
    "none of the blond people are nice",
    "null",
    "all of the blond people are not nice",
    "none of the blond people are not nice",
]
nutt = length(utterances)

allNice(b1, n1, b2, n2) = (!b1 || n1) && (!b2 || n2)
noneNice(b1, n1, b2, n2) = (!b1 || !n1) && (!b2 || !n2)

# scope_idx: 1 = surface, 2 = inverse. Only utterance 4 ("all ... are not nice") is
# scope-ambiguous; the other four always take their single fixed reading.
function literalTruth(ui, sci, b1, n1, b2, n2)
    if ui == 1
        return allNice(b1, n1, b2, n2)
    elseif ui == 2
        return noneNice(b1, n1, b2, n2)
    elseif ui == 3
        return true
    elseif ui == 4
        return sci == 2 ? !allNice(b1, n1, b2, n2) : noneNice(b1, n1, b2, n2)
    else
        return allNice(b1, n1, b2, n2)
    end
end

# L0: literal listener given (utt_idx, scope_idx) -> Dict{(b1,n1,b2,n2) => prob}
function literalListener(utt_idx, scope_idx)
    @gen function m()
        b1 = ({:b1} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
        n1 = ({:n1} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
        b2 = ({:b2} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
        n2 = ({:n2} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
        ok = literalTruth(utt_idx, scope_idx, b1, n1, b2, n2)
        {:c} ~ bernoulli(ok ? 1.0 : 0.0)
        return (b1, n1, b2, n2)
    end
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:c, true)),
        choice_vol_grid((:b1, [false, true]), (:n1, [false, true]), (:b2, [false, true]), (:n2, [false, true])))
    w = exp.(lw)
    d = Dict{NTuple{4,Bool}, Float64}()
    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w)
        r = get_retval(t); d[r] = get(d, r, 0.0) + wi
    end
    s = sum(values(d)); if s > 0; for k in keys(d); d[k] /= s; end; end
    return d
end

# listener: given utt_idx -> Dict{(b1,n1,b2,n2) => prob}, jointly sampling world & scope

function listenerDist(utt_idx)
    @gen function m()
        b1 = ({:b1} ~ bernoulli(0.5)); n1 = ({:n1} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
        b2 = ({:b2} ~ bernoulli(0.5)); n2 = ({:n2} ~ bernoulli(0.5))

        world = (b1, n1, b2, n2)
        {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(LOG(Scache[(world, sci)][utt_idx]))
        return world
    end
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:pot, 0.0)),
        choice_vol_grid((:b1, [false, true]), (:n1, [false, true]), (:b2, [false, true]),
                         (:n2, [false, true]), (:sc, [1, 2])))
    w = exp.(lw)
    d = Dict{NTuple{4,Bool}, Float64}()
    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w)
        r = get_retval(t); d[r] = get(d, r, 0.0) + wi
    end
    s = sum(values(d)); if s > 0; for k in keys(d); d[k] /= s; end; end

@gen function default_order_model()
    epsBrown0 = brownEps + (3 - 1) * 0.04
    bA = ({:bA} ~ bernoulli(Abrown ? 1 - epsBrown0 : epsBrown0))
    bB = ({:bB} ~ bernoulli(Bbrown ? 1 - epsBrown0 : epsBrown0))
    bC = ({:bC} ~ bernoulli(Cbrown ? 1 - epsBrown0 : epsBrown0))
    brownSetSize = (bA ? 1 : 0) + (bB ? 1 : 0) + (bC ? 1 : 0)
    epsSmall1 = smallEps + (brownSetSize - 1) * 0.04
    sA = ({:sA} ~ bernoulli(Asmall ? 1 - epsSmall1 : epsSmall1))
    sB = ({:sB} ~ bernoulli(Bsmall ? 1 - epsSmall1 : epsSmall1))
    sC = ({:sC} ~ bernoulli(Csmall ? 1 - epsSmall1 : epsSmall1))
    return bA && sA
end

@gen function reverse_order_model()
    epsSmall0 = smallEps + (3 - 1) * 0.04
    sA = ({:sA} ~ bernoulli(Asmall ? 1 - epsSmall0 : epsSmall0))
    sB = ({:sB} ~ bernoulli(Bsmall ? 1 - epsSmall0 : epsSmall0))
    sC = ({:sC} ~ bernoulli(Csmall ? 1 - epsSmall0 : epsSmall0))
    smallSetSize = (sA ? 1 : 0) + (sB ? 1 : 0) + (sC ? 1 : 0)
    epsBrown1 = brownEps + (smallSetSize - 1) * 0.04
    bA = ({:bA} ~ bernoulli(Abrown ? 1 - epsBrown1 : epsBrown1))
    bB = ({:bB} ~ bernoulli(Bbrown ? 1 - epsBrown1 : epsBrown1))
    bC = ({:bC} ~ bernoulli(Cbrown ? 1 - epsBrown1 : epsBrown1))
    return sA && bA
end

function prob_true(model)
    traces, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(model, (), choicemap(),
        choice_vol_grid((:bA, [false, true]), (:bB, [false, true]), (:bC, [false, true]),
                         (:sA, [false, true]), (:sB, [false, true]), (:sC, [false, true])))
    w = exp.(lw)
    p = 0.0
    for (t, wi) in zip(traces, w)
        if get_retval(t); p += wi; end
    end
    return p
end

# PPLGYM_SAMPLE
# 10-round reference-game simulation. Each RSA layer (L0, S1, L1, and the lexicon-
# uncertain S_uncertain/L_uncertain) is computed by Gen's own enumerative_inference:
# the "rational" component of each WebPPL Mixture({uniform, Infer(enumerate){...factor...}})
# is a real enumerative_inference call; the fixed guessingEpsilon mixture weight is then
# folded in as plain-arithmetic post-processing (the mixture combinator itself, not
# inference -- same class as reading a posterior marginal and post-processing it).
# To keep this tractable (each layer would otherwise need a fresh enumerative_inference
# call per one of the 1000 lexicon draws), each layer is BATCHED over the 1000 draws in a
# SINGLE enumerative_inference call via a joint (outcome, lex-index) grid -- mirroring the
# Pyro reference's pyro.plate batching. The raw per-cell weights are Gen's own inference
# output; bucketing + renormalizing per lex-index is the same post-processing the
# non-batched form would do, just amortized into one call. The genuine stochasticity --
# and the only source of cross-run noise -- is: each partner's 1000-sample forward draw
# from their current Beta belief each round, and the two actual utterance/object
# choices sampled each round (which drive the belief updates feeding into later rounds).
# Each seed replays the whole 10-round history once.

uttWords = [[1],[2],[3],[4],[1,2],[3,4]]
uttCost = [1,1,1,1,2,2]
nUtt = 6

function lexElem(u::Int, blueTarget::Bool, lex::Vector{Float64})
    v = 1.0
    for w in uttWords[u]
        v *= blueTarget ? lex[w] : (1.0 - lex[w])
    end
    return v
end

const EPS = 0.01
const ALPHA = 16.0
const COSTW = 0.2

LOG(p) = p > 0 ? log(p) : -Inf

# ONE enumerative_inference call over a joint (outcome in 1:n, batch in 1:B) grid; returns
# the n x B matrix of per-batch-column normalized, eps-mixed probabilities. logscore(i,b) is
# the plain-Julia log-factor for outcome i at batch item b (mirrors the WebPPL guessing-
# epsilon Mixture: rational component from real inference, eps-uniform folded in after).
function enum_mix_batched(logscore::Function, n::Int, B::Int, eps::Float64)
    @gen function m()
        i = ({:i} ~ uniform_discrete(1, n))
        b = ({:b} ~ uniform_discrete(1, B))
        {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(logscore(i, b))
        return (i, b)
    end
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:pot, 0.0)),
        choice_vol_grid((:i, collect(1:n)), (:b, collect(1:B))))
    w = exp.(lw)
    raw = zeros(n, B)
    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w)
        (i, b) = get_retval(t)
        raw[i, b] += wi
    end
    out = zeros(n, B)
    for b in 1:B
        s = sum(raw[:, b])
        rational = s > 0 ? raw[:, b] ./ s : fill(1.0/n, n)
        out[:, b] = eps .* (1.0/n) .+ (1-eps) .* rational
    end
    return out
end

# L0 for a fixed utterance u, batched over a lex-sample vector: 2xN matrix, row1=P(blue), row2=P(red)
function L0_batch(u::Int, lexBatch::Vector{Vector{Float64}})
    N = length(lexBatch)
    logscore(oi, li) = LOG(lexElem(u, oi == 1, lexBatch[li]))
    return enum_mix_batched(logscore, 2, N, EPS)
end

# S1 for a fixed target object, batched over lex: nUtt x N matrix
function S1_batch(blueTarget::Bool, lexBatch::Vector{Vector{Float64}}, L0tab::Vector{Matrix{Float64}})
    N = length(lexBatch)
    row = blueTarget ? 1 : 2
    function logscore(ui, li)
        pb = L0tab[ui][row, li]
        util = (1-COSTW)*LOG(pb) - COSTW*uttCost[ui]
        return ALPHA*util
    end
    return enum_mix_batched(logscore, nUtt, N, EPS)
end

# L1 for a fixed utterance u, batched over lex: 2xN matrix, row1=P(blue), row2=P(red)
function L1_batch(u::Int, lexBatch::Vector{Vector{Float64}}, S1true::Matrix{Float64}, S1false::Matrix{Float64})
    N = length(lexBatch)
    function logscore(oi, li)
        s1 = oi == 1 ? S1true[u, li] : S1false[u, li]
        return ALPHA*log(s1)
    end
    return enum_mix_batched(logscore, 2, N, EPS)
end

# lexicon-uncertain speaker/listener: NO guessing-epsilon mixture (matches WebPPL
# S_uncertain/L_uncertain, which are plain Infer(enumerate), not wrapped in a Mixture)
function sUncertain(blueTarget::Bool, lexBatch::Vector{Vector{Float64}})
    N = length(lexBatch)
    L0tab = [L0_batch(u, lexBatch) for u in 1:nUtt]
    S1true = S1_batch(true, lexBatch, L0tab)
    S1false = S1_batch(false, lexBatch, L0tab)
    L1tab = [L1_batch(u, lexBatch, S1true, S1false) for u in 1:nUtt]
    row = blueTarget ? 1 : 2
    logscores = zeros(nUtt)
    for u in 1:nUtt
        acc = 0.0
        for li in 1:N
            acc += log(L1tab[u][row, li])
        end
        inf = acc / N
        util = (1-COSTW)*inf - COSTW*uttCost[u]
        logscores[u] = ALPHA*util
    end
    @gen function m()
        ui = ({:u} ~ uniform_discrete(1, nUtt))
        {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(logscores[ui])
        return ui
    end
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:pot, 0.0)), choice_vol_grid((:u, collect(1:nUtt))))
    w = exp.(lw)
    d = zeros(nUtt)
    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w); d[get_retval(t)] += wi; end
    s = sum(d)
    return s > 0 ? d ./ s : fill(1.0/nUtt, nUtt)
end

function lUncertain(u::Int, lexBatch::Vector{Vector{Float64}})
    N = length(lexBatch)
    L0tab = [L0_batch(uu, lexBatch) for uu in 1:nUtt]
    S1true = S1_batch(true, lexBatch, L0tab)
    S1false = S1_batch(false, lexBatch, L0tab)
    logscores = zeros(2)
    for (oi, s1) in enumerate((S1true, S1false))
        acc = 0.0
        for li in 1:N
            acc += log(s1[u, li])
        end
        logscores[oi] = ALPHA * (acc / N)
    end
    @gen function m()
        oi = ({:o} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 2))
        {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(logscores[oi])
        return oi
    end
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:pot, 0.0)), choice_vol_grid((:o, [1, 2])))
    w = exp.(lw)
    d = zeros(2)
    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w); d[get_retval(t)] += wi; end
    s = sum(d)
    post = s > 0 ? d ./ s : [0.5, 0.5]
    return (post[1], post[2])
end

    for k in 1:K

    end
    return samples
end

function literal_listener0(is_null::Bool, threshold::Float64, prior::Vector{Float64})
    @gen function m()
        si = ({:s} ~ categorical(prior))
        state = stateBins[si]
        ok = is_null ? true : (state > threshold)
        {:c} ~ bernoulli(ok ? 1.0 : 0.0)

    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:c, true)), choice_vol_grid((:s, collect(1:nstate))))
    w = exp.(lw)
    d = zeros(nstate)
    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w); d[get_retval(t)] += wi; end
    s = sum(d)
    return s > 0 ? d ./ s : d
end

# returns listener1(utt_idx) for a given background `prior`; utt_idx 1 = the threshold-adjective
# ("tall" for the height background, "generic" for the kind-prevalence background), 2 = null.
function make_listener1(prior::Vector{Float64})
    L0_adj = Dict{Float64,Vector{Float64}}()
    L0_null = Dict{Float64,Vector{Float64}}()
    for th in thresholdBins
        L0_adj[th] = literal_listener0(false, th, prior)
        L0_null[th] = literal_listener0(true, th, prior)
    end
    S1 = Dict{Tuple{Int,Float64},Vector{Float64}}()
    function speaker1(si::Int, th::Float64)
        key = (si, th)
        if haskey(S1, key); return S1[key]; end
        l0_a = L0_adj[th]; l0_n = L0_null[th]
        @gen function m()
            ui = ({:u} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 2))
            l0 = ui == 1 ? l0_a : l0_n
            {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(s1optimality * LOG(l0[si]))
            return ui
        end
        tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:pot, 0.0)), choice_vol_grid((:u, [1, 2])))
        w = exp.(lw)
        d = zeros(2)
        for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w); d[get_retval(t)] += wi; end
        s = sum(d)
        res = s > 0 ? d ./ s : d
        S1[key] = res
        return res
    end
    function listener1(utt_idx::Int)
        @gen function m()
            si = ({:s} ~ categorical(prior))
            ti = ({:t} ~ uniform_discrete(1, nthresh))
            th = thresholdBins[ti]
            s1 = speaker1(si, th)
            {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(LOG(s1[utt_idx]))
            return si
        end
        tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:pot, 0.0)),
            choice_vol_grid((:s, collect(1:nstate)), (:t, collect(1:nthresh))))
        w = exp.(lw)
        d = zeros(nstate)
        for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w); d[get_retval(t)] += wi; end
        s = sum(d)
        return s > 0 ? d ./ s : d
    end
    return listener1
end

# literal listener: real enumerative_inference over the empirical state-prior support
# (state drawn `categorical`ly by its empirical weight, matching WebPPL's `sample(statePrior)`),
# hard-conditioned on the utterance's meaning; returns Dict(prevalence => prob). Memoized.
L0cache = Dict{Tuple{String,Float64},Dict{Float64,Float64}}()
function literal_listener(utt::String, thresh::Float64)

    L0cache[key] = d
    return d
end

# learner(utterance_or_nothing, obs_or_nothing) -> Dict(state=>prob); obs = (positive,negative)
# or nothing. Real enumerative_inference jointly over (state, threshold), with a soft factor
# for the speaker1-utterance likelihood and/or the binomial-observation likelihood.
learnerCache = Dict{Tuple{Any,Any},Dict{Tuple{Int,Float64},Float64}}()
function learner(utt, obs)
    key = (utt, obs)
    if haskey(learnerCache, key); return learnerCache[key]; end
    function logscore(si, ti)
        (ty, prev) = stateKeys[si]
        thresh = thresholdBins[ti]
        lp = 0.0
        if utt !== nothing
            S1 = speaker1(prev, thresh)
            lp += LOG(get(S1, utt, 0.0))
        end
        if obs !== nothing
            pos, neg = obs
            lp += LOG(binomial(pos + neg, pos) * prev^pos * (1-prev)^neg)
        end
        return lp
    end
    @gen function m()
        si = ({:s} ~ categorical(stateWeights))
        ti = ({:t} ~ uniform_discrete(1, nThresh))
        {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(logscore(si, ti))
        return stateKeys[si]
    end
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:pot, 0.0)),
        choice_vol_grid((:s, collect(1:nStates)), (:t, collect(1:nThresh))))
    w = exp.(lw)
    d = Dict{Tuple{Int,Float64},Float64}()
    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w)
        rv = get_retval(t)
        d[rv] = get(d, rv, 0.0) + wi
    end
    tot = sum(values(d))
    if tot > 0; for kk in keys(d); d[kk] /= tot; end; end
    learnerCache[key] = d
    return d
end

function marginalize_prevalence(d::Dict{Tuple{Int,Float64},Float64})
    out = Dict{Float64,Float64}()
    for ((ty,prev), w) in d
        out[prev] = get(out, prev, 0.0) + w
    end
    return out
end

for utt in ("generic","silence")

# speaker: real enumerative_inference over (belief-state, utterance), factored by
# alpha2 * L1cache[utterance].score(belief_state.prevalence)
function speaker(beliefs::Dict{Tuple{Int,Float64},Float64})
    beliefKeys = collect(keys(beliefs))
    beliefW = [beliefs[k] for k in beliefKeys]
    nB = length(beliefKeys)
    function logscore(bi, ui)
        (ty, prev) = beliefKeys[bi]
        utt = ui == 1 ? "generic" : "silence"
        L1 = L1cache[utt]
        return alpha2 * LOG(get(L1, prev, 0.0))
    end
    @gen function m()
        bi = ({:b} ~ categorical(beliefW))
        ui = ({:u} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 2))
        {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(logscore(bi, ui))
        return ui == 1 ? "generic" : "silence"
    end
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:pot, 0.0)),
        choice_vol_grid((:b, collect(1:nB)), (:u, [1, 2])))
    w = exp.(lw)
    d = Dict{String,Float64}("generic"=>0.0, "silence"=>0.0)
    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w)
        rv = get_retval(t)
        d[rv] = get(d, rv, 0.0) + wi
    end
    tot = sum(values(d))
    if tot > 0; for k in keys(d); d[k] /= tot; end; end
    return d
end

# world: Binomial(10,0.1) distribution over x = 0..10 -- itself the queried quantity
# (an unconditioned prior), not something inferred; closed-form pmf, same treatment as
# the Pyro reference's `dist.Binomial(...).log_prob(...)`.
worldDist = Dict{Int,Float64}()
for x in 0:10
    worldDist[x] = binomial(10,x) * 0.1^x * 0.9^(10-x)
end
wtot = sum(values(worldDist)); for k in keys(worldDist); worldDist[k] /= wtot; end

# learner_population: sample(speakerDist) -> sample(world) -> sample(learner(utt,obs)). This
# is a MIXTURE of learner()'s already-computed (real-inference) posteriors weighted by the
# KNOWN priors P(utt)*P(obs) -- not further inference (learner() is where the actual
# conditioning happens); combining already-normalized distributions with fixed weights is
# the same post-processing as the eps-guessing mixture used elsewhere in this codebase.
function learner_population(speakerDist::Dict{String,Float64})
    d = Dict{Tuple{Int,Float64},Float64}()
    for utt in ("generic","silence")
        pu = get(speakerDist, utt, 0.0)
        if pu == 0; continue; end
        for x in 0:10
            pw = worldDist[x]
            obs = (x, 10-x)
            Ld = learner(utt, obs)
            for (s, ws) in Ld
                d[s] = get(d, s, 0.0) + pu * pw * ws
            end
        end
    end
    tot = sum(values(d))
    if tot > 0; for k in keys(d); d[k] /= tot; end; end
    return d
end

function structured_prior_probs(theta::Float64, mu::Float64, sigma::Float64)
    dens = [gaussian_pdf(b, mu, sigma) for b in statebins]
    dens = dens ./ sum(dens)
    probs = zeros(nstate)
    probs[1] += (1 - theta)     # minBin = statebins[1] = -1.0, the "gate false" outcome
    probs .+= theta .* dens
    return probs
end

function nearest_prior_bin(x::Float64)
    lo, hi = minimum(statebins), maximum(statebins)
    if x > hi; return hi; end
    if x < lo; return lo; end
    idx = round(Int, ((x - lo) / (hi - lo)) * (nstate - 1)) + 1
    return statebins[idx]
end

function log_frequency(instances::Float64, interval::String)
    extend = Dict("week" => 5 * 52.0, "month" => 5 * 12.0, "year" => 5.0, "5 years" => 1.0)
    logf = log(instances * extend[interval])
    return nearest_prior_bin(logf)
end

function get_transitions(str::String)
    parts = split(str, " ")
    return [join(parts[1:i], " ") for i in 1:length(parts)]
end

licit_transitions = unique(vcat([get_transitions(u) for u in full_utts]...))

context_str(ws::Vector{String}) = join(ws, " ")

function literal_prefix_true(context_words::Vector{String}, state::String)
    if isempty(context_words)
        return true   # mirrors WebPPL's stringMeanings("") NaN != 0 quirk: never treated as false
    end
    m = semantics(state)
    return all(m[w] for w in context_words)
end

function string_semantics(prefix::String, state::String)
    all_conts = filter(u -> startswith(u, prefix), full_utts)
    if isempty(all_conts); return 0.0; end
    true_conts = sum(literal_prefix_true(String.(split(u, " ")), state) ? 1.0 : 0.0 for u in all_conts)
    return true_conts / length(all_conts)
end

function incremental_literal_listener(prefix::String)
    @gen function m()
        si = ({:s} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
        state = states[si]
        w = string_semantics(prefix, state)
        {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(LOG(w))
        return si
    end
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:pot, 0.0)), choice_vol_grid((:s, collect(1:3))))
    w = exp.(lw)
    d = zeros(3)
    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w); d[get_retval(t)] += wi; end
    s = sum(d)
    return s > 0 ? d ./ s : d
end

function word_speaker_dist(context_words::Vector{String}, state::String)
    ctx_true = literal_prefix_true(context_words, state)
    sidx = findfirst(==(state), states)
    @gen function m()
        wi = ({:w} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 5))
        word = words[wi]
        new_context = vcat(context_words, [word])
        licit = context_str(new_context) in licit_transitions
        {:c} ~ bernoulli(licit ? 1.0 : 0.0)
        if ctx_true
            lincr = incremental_literal_listener(context_str(new_context))
            {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(LOG(lincr[sidx]))
        else
            {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(0.0)
        end
        return wi
    end
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:c, true), (:pot, 0.0)),
        choice_vol_grid((:w, collect(1:5))))
    w = exp.(lw)
    d = zeros(5)
    for (t, wi_) in zip(tr, w); d[get_retval(t)] += wi_; end
    s = sum(d)
    return s > 0 ? d ./ s : d
end

function incremental_prob(utt::String, state::String)
    toks = String.(split(utt, " "))
    total = 1.0
    for i in 1:length(toks)
        context = toks[1:i-1]
        d = word_speaker_dist(context, state)
        widx = findfirst(==(toks[i]), words)
        total *= d[widx]
    end
    return total
end

        si = ({:s} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
        state = states[si]

        {:c} ~ bernoulli(truth ? 1.0 : 0.0)
        return si
    end
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:c, true)), choice_vol_grid((:s, collect(1:3))))
    w = exp.(lw)
    d = zeros(3)
    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w); d[get_retval(t)] += wi; end
    s = sum(d)
    return s > 0 ? d ./ s : d
end

function meaningVal(utt, obj)
    parts = split(utt, "_")
    if length(parts) == 1
        w = parts[1]
        if w in colors
            return w == obj["color"] ? color_semvalue : 1 - color_semvalue
        else
            return w == obj["size"] ? size_semvalue : 1 - size_semvalue
        end
    else
        sizeval = parts[1] == obj["size"] ? size_semvalue : 1 - size_semvalue
        colorval = parts[2] == obj["color"] ? color_semvalue : 1 - color_semvalue
        return sizeval * colorval
    end
end

function erfApprox(x::Float64)
    a1 =  0.254829592
    a2 = -0.284496736
    a3 =  1.421413741
    a4 = -1.453152027
    a5 =  1.061405429
    p5 =  0.3275911
    s = x < 0 ? -1.0 : 1.0
    z = abs(x)
    t = 1.0 / (1.0 + p5 * z)
    y = 1.0 - (((((a5*t + a4)*t) + a3)*t + a2)*t + a1)*t*exp(-z*z)
    return s * y
end

function collWeight(state, collTheta, noise)
    w = 1.0 - 0.5 * (1.0 + erfApprox((collTheta - sum(state)) / (noise * sqrt(2.0))))
    return w == 0.0 ? 0.01 : w == 1.0 ? 0.99 : w
end

function truthProb(uttIdx, state, distTheta, collTheta, iscollective)
    if uttIdx == 1
        return 1.0
    elseif uttIdx == 3
        return distWeight(state, distTheta)
    elseif uttIdx == 4
        return collWeight(state, collTheta, noiseScale)
    else

    end

function theta_bins(theta::Float64)
    half = theta / 2

function coverage(indicator::Vector{Bool}, theta::Float64)
    b0, b1, b2 = theta_bins(theta)
    hit1, hit2 = false, false
    for i in 1:nslots

            v = allstates[i]
            if v > b0 && v <= b1; hit1 = true; end
            if v > b1 && v <= b2; hit2 = true; end

end

    referent = referents[referentIdx]
    probs = qudProbs(qud)
    L0cache = [literalListenerDist(ui, interp, qud) for ui in 1:2]
    @gen function m()
        ui = ({:u} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 2))
        qi = ({:q} ~ categorical(probs))
        qreferent = (referent == referents[qi])
        {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(alpha * LOG(L0cache[ui][qreferent]))
        return ui
    end
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:pot, 0.0)),
        choice_vol_grid((:u, collect(1:2)), (:q, collect(1:nref))))
    w = exp.(lw)
    d = zeros(2)
    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w)
        d[get_retval(t)] += wi
    end
    tot = sum(d)
    return tot > 0 ? d ./ tot : d
end

# PPLGYM_SAMPLE
# WebPPL uses Infer({method:'SMC', particles:10000}) on a model with a single
# mapData datum (one observe + one factor, no sequential structure to resample
# between) -- SMC degenerates to self-normalized importance sampling with 10000
# particles. Gen.importance_sampling runs the real @gen model (the reward
# observation and the "other agents' choices" likelihood both live in the model
# as a real observation address + a real __pplgym_factor) over 10000 particles
# and returns each particle's real trace log-weight; we then resample 10000
# equal-weight draws from that weighted set via Gen's own `categorical`
# distribution (the SMC particle-cloud analogue).

trunc01(x) = x <= 0 ? 0.001 : (x >= 1 ? 0.999 : x)

N = 10000

@gen function model()
    meanBB = ({:meanBB} ~ beta(1.0, 1.0))
    meanSS = ({:meanSS} ~ beta(1.0, 1.0))
    sd = ({:sd} ~ uniform(0.0, 0.15))
    ownBB = trunc01(({:ownBB_raw} ~ normal(meanBB, sd)))
    ownSS = trunc01(({:ownSS_raw} ~ normal(meanSS, sd)))

    logw_others = 0.0
    for j in 1:3   # the three other agents, all of whom chose Stirfry Shack
        oBB = trunc01(({(:oBB, j)} ~ normal(meanBB, sd)))
        oSS = trunc01(({(:oSS, j)} ~ normal(meanSS, sd)))
        logw_others += log(oSS / (oBB + oSS))
    end

    {:obs_reward} ~ bernoulli(ownBB)          # Alice's reward signal, observed true
    {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(logw_others)     # otherLikelihoods factor

    return (ownBB, ownSS)
end

obs = choicemap((:obs_reward, true), (:pot, 0.0))
traces, log_norm_weights, _ = Gen.importance_sampling(model, (), obs, N)
probs = exp.(log_norm_weights)
probs ./= sum(probs)

for _ in 1:N
    idx = Gen.random(categorical, probs)
    ownBB, ownSS = get_retval(traces[idx])
    push!(bbResampled, ownBB)
    push!(ssResampled, ownSS)
end

function cellOf(qud_idx, world_idx)
    if qud_idx == 1
        return world_idx
    elseif qud_idx == 2       # isSome: {No} vs {Just some, All}
        return world_idx == 1 ? 1 : 2
    else                       # isAll: {No, Just some} vs {All}

    qi = ({:q} ~ categorical(qudProbs))
    {:c} ~ bernoulli(trueAt(utt_idx, wi, lex_idx) ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    return (cellOf(qi, wi), qi)
end

function literalListener(utt_idx, lex_idx)
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(L0_model, (utt_idx, lex_idx), choicemap((:c, true)),
        choice_vol_grid((:w, collect(1:nworld)), (:q, collect(1:nqud))))

    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w)

    end
    s = sum(values(d)); if s > 0; for k in keys(d); d[k] /= s; end; end
    return d

# expectedUtility(utt,world,qud) = E_lexicon[ log L0(cellOf(qud,world),qud | utt,lex) ] - cost[utt]
function expectedUtility(utt_idx, world_idx, qud_idx)
    cell = cellOf(qud_idx, world_idx)
    total = 0.0
    for li in 1:2
        p = get(L0cache[(utt_idx, li)], (cell, qud_idx), 0.0)
        total += 0.5 * (LOG(p) - costvec[utt_idx])
    end
    return total
end

# speaker at recursion level `level`: given (world_idx, qud_idx, level, prevListenerByUtt) ->
# prob vector over utterances. level==1 uses the lexicon-averaged expectedUtility; level>=2
# uses the level-(level-1) pragmatic listener's log-prob of (world,qud) given that utterance.
@gen function speaker_model(world_idx::Int, qud_idx::Int, level::Int, prevListenerByUtt)
    ui = ({:u} ~ uniform_discrete(1, nutt))
    util = level == 1 ? expectedUtility(ui, world_idx, qud_idx) :
           (LOG(get(prevListenerByUtt[ui], (world_idx, qud_idx), 0.0)) - costvec[ui])
    {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(lambda * util)
    return ui
end

    w = exp.(lw); d = zeros(nutt)
    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w); d[get_retval(t)] += wi; end
    s = sum(d); return s > 0 ? d ./ s : d
end

@gen function situation_model(prior::Vector{Float64})
    idx = Int[]
    for i in 1:4
        ti = ({(:t, i)} ~ categorical(prior))
        push!(idx, ti)
    end

    present = falses(8)
    for ti in idx
        present[ti] = true
    end

    # property indices: A=1, B=2, C=3
    plentiful = hasProp(present, 1) && hasProp(present, 2) && hasProp(present, 3)
    someBA = hasXandY(present, 2, 1)      # "some B are A"
    allCB = !hasXnotY(present, 3, 2)      # "all C are B"
    premisesTrue = someBA && allCB

    allCA = !hasXnotY(present, 3, 1)
    someCA = hasXandY(present, 3, 1)
    # notallCA = !allCA, noneCA = !someCA -- exact logical complements (always well-defined)

    ok = plentiful && premisesTrue
    {:ok} ~ __pplgym_factor(ok ? 0.0 : -Inf)

    pick = ({:pick} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
    label = pick ? (allCA ? "all C are A" : "not all C are A") :
                   (someCA ? "some C are A" : "none C are A")
    return label
end

function worldOf(ua::Bool, ub::Bool, ula::Bool, ulb::Bool, uw::Bool)
    A = ua ? 2 : 1
    B = ub ? 2 : 1
    LA = ula
    LB = ulb
    PA = LA ? 0.5*A : Float64(A)
    PB = LB ? 0.5*B : Float64(B)
    W = PA > PB ? "A" : (PB > PA ? "B" : (uw ? "A" : "B"))
    Astr = A == 2 ? "strong" : "weak"
    Bstr = B == 2 ? "strong" : "weak"
    return (A=Astr, B=Bstr, LA=LA, LB=LB, W=W)
end

aliceNotLazy(w) = !w.LA

function condEval(flag::Int, w)
    if flag == 1; return aliceStrong(w)

function reduce_dist(res)
    traces, logw = res[1], res[2]
    w = exp.(logw)
    d = Dict{Any,Float64}()
    for (t, wi) in zip(traces, w)
        r = get_retval(t)
        d[r] = get(d, r, 0.0) + wi
    end
    tot = sum(values(d))
    if tot > 0
        for k in keys(d); d[k] /= tot; end
    end
    return d
end

# --- counterfactual "because" check: sticky-resample each of the 5 background
# bits (keep w.p. stickiness=0.5, else redraw fresh from its own prior), condition
# on the named fact being false in the counterfactual world, and measure P(Alice
# does not win | fact false). Faithful 10-bit enumeration of the WebPPL structure.
@gen function cf_model(actual::NTuple{5,Bool}, condFlag::Int)
    keepA = ({:keepA} ~ bernoulli(0.5)); freshA = ({:freshA} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
    keepB = ({:keepB} ~ bernoulli(0.5)); freshB = ({:freshB} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
    keepLA = ({:keepLA} ~ bernoulli(0.5)); freshLA = ({:freshLA} ~ bernoulli(0.3))
    keepLB = ({:keepLB} ~ bernoulli(0.5)); freshLB = ({:freshLB} ~ bernoulli(0.3))
    keepW = ({:keepW} ~ bernoulli(0.5)); freshW = ({:freshW} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
    ua2 = keepA ? actual[1] : freshA
    ub2 = keepB ? actual[2] : freshB
    ula2 = keepLA ? actual[3] : freshLA
    ulb2 = keepLB ? actual[4] : freshLB
    uw2 = keepW ? actual[5] : freshW
    cfworld = worldOf(ua2, ub2, ula2, ulb2, uw2)
    condFalse = !condEval(condFlag, cfworld)
    {:c} ~ bernoulli(condFalse ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    return !aliceWin(cfworld)
end

    elseif uttIdx == 5

    elseif uttIdx == 6

    elseif uttIdx == 7

    elseif uttIdx == 8

    elseif uttIdx == 10

function discrete_beta_probs(g::Float64, d::Float64)
    a = g * d
    b = (1 - g) * d
    w = [x^(a - 1) * (1 - x)^(b - 1) for x in bins]
    return w ./ sum(w)
end

S1cache = Dict{Tuple{Int,Int,Int}, Vector{Float64}}()
for pidx in 1:nprices, ei in 1:nprices, ii in 1:nprices
    @gen function m()
        ui = ({:u} ~ uniform_discrete(1, nutt))
        u = utterances[ui]
        w = alpha * (scoreL0(L0cache[(ui, ei, ii)], pidx) - costOf[u])
        {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(w)
        return ui
    end
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:pot, 0.0)), choice_vol_grid((:u, collect(1:nutt))))
    w = exp.(lw); d = zeros(nutt)
    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w); d[get_retval(t)] += wi; end
    S1cache[(pidx, ei, ii)] = d ./ sum(d)
end

function pragmaticExpectedPrice(targetUtterance)
    target_ui = findfirst(==(targetUtterance), utterances)
    @gen function m()
        anNeg = ({:an} ~ bernoulli(0.2))
        ei = ({:ei} ~ uniform_discrete(1, nprices))
        ii_fresh = ({:iif} ~ uniform_discrete(1, nprices))
        ii = anNeg ? ii_fresh : ei
        pidx = ({:p} ~ categorical(sweater_probs))
        {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(LOG(S1cache[(pidx, ei, ii)][target_ui]))
        return sweater_prices[pidx]
    end
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:pot, 0.0)),
        choice_vol_grid((:an, [true, false]), (:ei, collect(1:nprices)), (:iif, collect(1:nprices)), (:p, collect(1:nprices))))
    w = exp.(lw)
    tot = sum(w)
    num = 0.0
    for (t, wi) in zip(tr, w)
        num += wi * get_retval(t)
    end
    return num / tot
end

using Gen, Statistics

function accept_prob(offer::Float64, alpha::Float64)
    return (offer / 10.0) ^ alpha
end

@gen function offer_rejection_model()
    alpha = ({:alpha} ~ uniform(0.5, 5.0))
    p = accept_prob(2.0, alpha)
    ({:accepted} ~ bernoulli(p))
    return alpha
end

function run_alpha_posterior(n_samples::Int)
    obs = choicemap((:accepted, false))
    (tr, _) = generate(offer_rejection_model, (), obs)
    samples = Float64[]
    for it in 1:n_samples
        (tr, _) = mh(tr, select(:alpha))
        push!(samples, tr[:alpha])
    end
    return samples
end

@gen function round2_model(alpha2::Float64)
    offer2 = ({:offer2} ~ uniform_discrete(0, 10))
    p2 = accept_prob(Float64(offer2), alpha2)
    accepted2 = ({:accepted2} ~ bernoulli(p2))
    reward2 = accepted2 ? (10.0 - offer2) : 0.0
    ({:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(reward2))
    return offer2
end

function run_round2_offer(alpha2::Float64, n_inner::Int)
    obs = choicemap((:pot, 0.0))
    (tr, _) = generate(round2_model, (alpha2,), obs)
    offers = Int[]
    for it in 1:n_inner
        (tr, _) = mh(tr, select(:offer2))
        (tr, _) = mh(tr, select(:accepted2))
        push!(offers, tr[:offer2])
    end
    return offers[rand(1:length(offers))]
end

function run_ultimatum_round2(n_alpha_samples::Int, n_outer::Int, n_inner::Int)
    alpha_samples = run_alpha_posterior(n_alpha_samples)
    round2_offers = Int[]
    for _ in 1:n_outer
        alpha2 = alpha_samples[rand(1:length(alpha_samples))]
        push!(round2_offers, run_round2_offer(alpha2, n_inner))
    end
    return round2_offers
end

# L0: literal listener — prob vector over obj indices, given utterance
function L0(u)
    @gen function m()
        oi = ({:o} ~ uniform_discrete(1, length(objs)))
        {:c} ~ bernoulli(meaning(u, objs[oi]) ? 1.0 : 0.0)
        return oi

    w = exp.(lw); d = zeros(length(objs))
    for (t,wi) in zip(tr,w); d[get_retval(t)] += wi; end
    return d ./ sum(d)
end

# S1: speaker — prob vector over utt indices, given obj index + alpha
function S1(oi, alpha, L0c)
    @gen function m()
        ui = ({:u} ~ uniform_discrete(1, length(utts)))
        {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(alpha * LOG0(L0c[ui][oi]))
        return ui
    end
    tr, lw, _ = enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:pot,0.0)), choice_vol_grid((:u, collect(1:length(utts)))))
    w = exp.(lw); d = zeros(length(utts))
    for (t,wi) in zip(tr,w); d[get_retval(t)] += wi; end
    return d ./ sum(d)
end

# L1: pragmatic listener — dist over objs, given utterance + alpha
function L1(u, alpha)
    L0c = [L0(uu) for uu in utts]                       # cache L0 per utterance
    S1c = [S1(oi, alpha, L0c) for oi in 1:length(objs)] # cache S1 per obj
    ui = findfirst(==(u), utts)
    @gen function m()
        oi = ({:o} ~ uniform_discrete(1, length(objs)))
        {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(LOG0(S1c[oi][ui]))
        return objs[oi]
    end
    __pplgym_enum_dist(enumerative_inference(m, (), choicemap((:pot,0.0)), choice_vol_grid((:o, collect(1:length(objs))))))
end

function listener(score_uo)  # score_uo(u,o): log-weight of obj o under utterance u
    L = [zeros(length(objs)) for _ in utts]
    for (ui,u) in enumerate(utts)
        @gen function m()
            oi = ({:o} ~ uniform_discrete(1,length(objs)))
            {:pot} ~ __pplgym_factor(score_uo(ui,oi))
            return oi
        end
        tr,lw,_ = enumerative_inference(m,(),choicemap((:pot,0.0)),choice_vol_grid((:o,collect(1:length(objs)))))
        w=exp.(lw); d=zeros(length(objs)); for (t,wi) in zip(tr,w); d[get_retval(t)]+=wi; end
        L[ui] = d ./ sum(d)
    end
    return L
end
function speaker(Lmat)  # Lmat[u][o]; speaker[o][u] ~ exp(alpha*log Lmat[u][o])
    S = [zeros(length(utts)) for _ in objs]
    for oi in 1:length(objs)
        @gen function m()
            ui = ({:u} ~ uniform_discrete(1,length(utts)))

            return ui
        end
        tr,lw,_ = enumerative_inference(m,(),choicemap((:pot,0.0)),choice_vol_grid((:u,collect(1:length(utts)))))
        w=exp.(lw); d=zeros(length(utts)); for (t,wi) in zip(tr,w); d[get_retval(t)]+=wi; end
        S[oi] = d ./ sum(d)
    end
    return S
end

using Gen, Statistics

const ALIEN_DATA = [
    (antennae=false, green=false, blargh=false),
    (antennae=true,  green=true,  blargh=true),
    (antennae=true,  green=true,  blargh=true),
    (antennae=true,  green=true,  blargh=true),
    (antennae=false, green=false, blargh=false),
    (antennae=true,  green=true,  blargh=true),
    (antennae=false, green=false, blargh=false),
    (antennae=true,  green=true,  blargh=true),
    (antennae=false, green=false, blargh=false),
    (antennae=false, green=false, blargh=false),
]

@gen function alien_mixture_model()
    g1_antennae = ({:g1_antennae} ~ beta(0.5, 0.5))
    g1_green    = ({:g1_green}    ~ beta(0.5, 0.5))
    g1_blargh   = ({:g1_blargh}   ~ beta(0.5, 0.5))
    g2_antennae = ({:g2_antennae} ~ beta(0.5, 0.5))
    g2_green    = ({:g2_green}    ~ beta(0.5, 0.5))
    g2_blargh   = ({:g2_blargh}   ~ beta(0.5, 0.5))
    for (i, d) in enumerate(ALIEN_DATA)
        is_g1 = ({(:group, i)} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
        pa = is_g1 ? g1_antennae : g2_antennae
        pg = is_g1 ? g1_green    : g2_green
        pb = is_g1 ? g1_blargh   : g2_blargh
        ({(:antennae, i)} ~ bernoulli(pa))
        ({(:green, i)}    ~ bernoulli(pg))
        ({(:blargh, i)}   ~ bernoulli(pb))
    end
    return nothing
end

function run_mixture(n_samples::Int)
    obs = choicemap()
    for (i, d) in enumerate(ALIEN_DATA)
        obs[(:antennae, i)] = d.antennae
        obs[(:green, i)] = d.green
        obs[(:blargh, i)] = d.blargh
    end
    (tr, _) = generate(alien_mixture_model, (), obs)

    addrs = Any[:g1_antennae, :g1_green, :g1_blargh, :g2_antennae, :g2_green, :g2_blargh]
    for i in 1:length(ALIEN_DATA)
        push!(addrs, (:group, i))
    end

    g1a = Float64[]; g1g = Float64[]; g1b = Float64[]
    g2a = Float64[]; g2g = Float64[]; g2b = Float64[]

    for it in 1:n_samples
        for a in addrs
            (tr, _) = mh(tr, select(a))
        end
        push!(g1a, tr[:g1_antennae]); push!(g1g, tr[:g1_green]); push!(g1b, tr[:g1_blargh])
        push!(g2a, tr[:g2_antennae]); push!(g2g, tr[:g2_green]); push!(g2b, tr[:g2_blargh])
    end

    g1_mean = mean(g1a)
    g2_mean = mean(g2a)
    if g1_mean < g2_mean
        low_a, low_g, low_b = g1a, g1g, g1b
        high_a, high_g, high_b = g2a, g2g, g2b
    else
        low_a, low_g, low_b = g2a, g2g, g2b
        high_a, high_g, high_b = g1a, g1g, g1b
    end

    return Dict(
        "low_antennae" => mean(low_a),
        "low_green" => mean(low_g),
        "low_blargh" => mean(low_b),
        "high_antennae" => mean(high_a),
        "high_green" => mean(high_g),
        "high_blargh" => mean(high_b),
    )
end

    (antennae=false, green=false, blargh=false),
    (antennae=false, green=false, blargh=false),
]

@gen function alien_mixture_mystery_model()
    g1_antennae = ({:g1_antennae} ~ beta(0.5, 0.5))
    g1_green    = ({:g1_green}    ~ beta(0.5, 0.5))
    g1_blargh   = ({:g1_blargh}   ~ beta(0.5, 0.5))
    g2_antennae = ({:g2_antennae} ~ beta(0.5, 0.5))
    g2_green    = ({:g2_green}    ~ beta(0.5, 0.5))
    g2_blargh   = ({:g2_blargh}   ~ beta(0.5, 0.5))
    for (i, d) in enumerate(ALIEN_DATA)
        is_g1 = ({(:group, i)} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
        pa = is_g1 ? g1_antennae : g2_antennae
        pg = is_g1 ? g1_green    : g2_green
        pb = is_g1 ? g1_blargh   : g2_blargh
        ({(:antennae, i)} ~ bernoulli(pa))
        ({(:green, i)}    ~ bernoulli(pg))
        ({(:blargh, i)}   ~ bernoulli(pb))
    end
    mystery_is_g1 = ({:mystery_group} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
    mb = mystery_is_g1 ? g1_blargh : g2_blargh
    ({:mystery_blargh} ~ bernoulli(mb))
    return nothing
end

function run_mixture_mystery(n_samples::Int)
    obs = choicemap()
    for (i, d) in enumerate(ALIEN_DATA)
        obs[(:antennae, i)] = d.antennae
        obs[(:green, i)] = d.green
        obs[(:blargh, i)] = d.blargh
    end
    obs[:mystery_blargh] = true

    (tr, _) = generate(alien_mixture_mystery_model, (), obs)

    addrs = Any[:g1_antennae, :g1_green, :g1_blargh, :g2_antennae, :g2_green, :g2_blargh, :mystery_group]
    for i in 1:length(ALIEN_DATA)
        push!(addrs, (:group, i))
    end

    g1a = Float64[]; g1g = Float64[]; g1b = Float64[]
    g2a = Float64[]; g2g = Float64[]; g2b = Float64[]
    mystery_g1 = Bool[]

    for it in 1:n_samples
        for a in addrs
            (tr, _) = mh(tr, select(a))
        end
        push!(g1a, tr[:g1_antennae]); push!(g1g, tr[:g1_green]); push!(g1b, tr[:g1_blargh])
        push!(g2a, tr[:g2_antennae]); push!(g2g, tr[:g2_green]); push!(g2b, tr[:g2_blargh])
        push!(mystery_g1, tr[:mystery_group])
    end

    g1_mean = mean(g1a)
    g2_mean = mean(g2a)
    high_is_g1 = g1_mean >= g2_mean

    if high_is_g1
        low_a, low_g, low_b = g2a, g2g, g2b
        high_a, high_g, high_b = g1a, g1g, g1b
    else
        low_a, low_g, low_b = g1a, g1g, g1b
        high_a, high_g, high_b = g2a, g2g, g2b
    end

    p_mystery_from_high = mean(Float64[(mystery_g1[i] == high_is_g1) ? 1.0 : 0.0 for i in 1:length(mystery_g1)])

    return Dict(
        "low_antennae" => mean(low_a),
        "low_green" => mean(low_g),
        "low_blargh" => mean(low_b),
        "high_antennae" => mean(high_a),
        "high_green" => mean(high_g),
        "high_blargh" => mean(high_b),
        "p_mystery_from_high" => p_mystery_from_high,
    )
end

@gen function model(scores)
    g1 = ({:g1} ~ uniform(0.5, 1.0))
    g2 = ({:g2} ~ uniform(0.0, g1))
    for (i, s) in enumerate(scores)
        grp = ({(:z, i)} ~ bernoulli(0.5))    # true = bona-fide (group1)
        # clamp only guards binom's domain; an out-of-support g1/g2 still gets -Inf from its uniform prior -> the move is rejected.
        p = clamp(grp ? g1 : g2, 1e-9, 1.0 - 1e-9)
        ({(:s, i)} ~ binom(45, p))
    end
    return (g1, g2)
end

using Gen, Statistics

function noisy_or_p(active::Bool, cp::Float64, b::Float64)
    return active ? (cp + (1.0 - cp) * b) : b
end

@gen function causal_power_model()
    relation = ({:relation} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
    cp = ({:cp} ~ uniform(0.0, 1.0))
    b  = ({:b}  ~ uniform(0.0, 1.0))
    p_e = noisy_or_p(relation, cp, b)   # C = true for the single observed trial
    ({:E} ~ bernoulli(p_e))
    return (relation, cp, b)
end

function run_posterior(n_samples::Int, lag::Int)
    obs = choicemap((:E, false))
    (tr, _) = generate(causal_power_model, (), obs)
    addrs = Any[:relation, :cp, :b]
    total = n_samples * lag
    relations = Bool[]
    cps = Float64[]
    bs = Float64[]
    for it in 1:total
        for a in addrs
            (tr, _) = mh(tr, select(a))
        end
        if it % lag == 0
            push!(relations, tr[:relation])
            push!(cps, tr[:cp])
            push!(bs, tr[:b])
        end
    end
    return (relations, cps, bs)
end

function make_dataset(num_e_with_c::Int, num_e_without_c::Int)
    trials = CausalTrial[]
    for _ in 1:num_e_with_c;            push!(trials, CausalTrial(true,  true));  end
    for _ in 1:(8 - num_e_with_c);      push!(trials, CausalTrial(true,  false)); end
    for _ in 1:num_e_without_c;         push!(trials, CausalTrial(false, true));  end
    for _ in 1:(8 - num_e_without_c);   push!(trials, CausalTrial(false, false)); end
    return trials
end

const DATA_PARAMS = [(8,8),(6,6),(4,4),(2,2),(0,0),(8,6),(6,4),(4,2),(2,0),
                      (8,4),(6,2),(4,0),(8,2),(6,0),(8,0)]
const ALL_TRIALS = [make_dataset(p[1], p[2]) for p in DATA_PARAMS]

@gen function cp_model(trials::Vector{CausalTrial})
    cp = ({:cp} ~ uniform(0.0, 1.0))
    b  = ({:b}  ~ uniform(0.0, 1.0))
    for (i, t) in enumerate(trials)
        p = noisy_or_p(t.C, cp, b)
        ({(:E, i)} ~ bernoulli(p))
    end
    return cp
end

@gen function cs_model(trials::Vector{CausalTrial})
    relation = ({:relation} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
    cp = ({:cp} ~ uniform(0.0, 1.0))
    b  = ({:b}  ~ uniform(0.0, 1.0))
    for (i, t) in enumerate(trials)
        active = relation && t.C
        p = noisy_or_p(active, cp, b)
        ({(:E, i)} ~ bernoulli(p))
    end
    return relation ? cp : 0.0
end

function run_cp_mean(trials::Vector{CausalTrial}, burn::Int, n_samples::Int, lag::Int)
    obs = choicemap()
    for (i, t) in enumerate(trials)
        obs[(:E, i)] = t.E
    end
    (tr, _) = generate(cp_model, (trials,), obs)
    addrs = Any[:cp, :b]
    total = burn + n_samples * lag
    cps = Float64[]
    for it in 1:total
        for a in addrs
            (tr, _) = mh(tr, select(a))
        end
        if it > burn && it % lag == 0
            push!(cps, tr[:cp])
        end
    end
    return mean(cps)
end

function run_cs_mean(trials::Vector{CausalTrial}, burn::Int, n_samples::Int, lag::Int)
    obs = choicemap()
    for (i, t) in enumerate(trials)
        obs[(:E, i)] = t.E
    end
    (tr, _) = generate(cs_model, (trials,), obs)
    addrs = Any[:relation, :cp, :b]
    total = burn + n_samples * lag
    vals = Float64[]
    for it in 1:total
        for a in addrs
            (tr, _) = mh(tr, select(a))
        end
        if it > burn && it % lag == 0
            push!(vals, tr[:relation] ? tr[:cp] : 0.0)
        end
    end
    return mean(vals)
end

@gen function monty(switches)
    alice = ({:a} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
    prize = ({:p} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
    m     = ({:m} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))

# montyAvoidBoth as a real, separately-NORMALIZED enumerative_inference per (alice,prize)
# — mirrors WebPPL's nested `sample(montyAvoidBoth(alice,prize))`. Folding both exclusions
# into the outer enumeration would reweight (alice,prize) since the valid-door count varies
# (1 when alice!=prize, 2 when ==), so the nested normalization must be preserved.
@gen function monty_model(alice, prize)
    m = ({:m} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
    {:c1} ~ bernoulli(m != alice ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    {:c2} ~ bernoulli(m != prize ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    return m
end
function monty_avoid_both(alice, prize)
    res = enumerative_inference(monty_model, (alice, prize),
                                choicemap((:c1, true), (:c2, true)),
                                choice_vol_grid((:m, [1, 2, 3])))
    traces, logw = res[1], res[2]
    w = exp.(logw); w = w ./ sum(w)
    probs = zeros(3)
    for (t, wi) in zip(traces, w); probs[get_retval(t)] += wi; end
    return probs
end
# precompute the normalized Monty distribution for every (alice,prize) — no inference inside @gen
MONTY = Dict((a, p) => monty_avoid_both(a, p) for a in 1:3, p in 1:3)
@gen function outer(switches)
    alice = ({:a} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
    prize = ({:p} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
    m     = ({:m} ~ categorical(MONTY[(alice, prize)]))   # sample from the normalized nested dist
    final = switches ? (6 - alice - m) : alice
    return final == prize
end
